summary: USBC, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting two routine operational items: a $5 million draw under an existing secured credit facility (master loan agreement with Payward Interactive) and an update on Phase 1 testing of its tokenized deposit product. No M&A, activist, strategic review, or other special-situation event is disclosed. The filing is a standard current report covering incremental borrowing under a previously disclosed facility and a business-development progress update, neither constituting a transformative corporate event.
